headword: {武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}
gloss: Mushanokojisenke; one of the three major tea-ceremony schools

definitions.gloss: Mushanokojisenke; one of the three major tea-ceremony schools
definitions.explanation: The third of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony, descended from the Sen family through the branch that inherited the Mushanokoji residence. Smaller in membership than Omotesenke and Urasenke, but historically and culturally on equal footing with them.

examples.japanese: {武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{千家|せんけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Mushanokojisenke is also one of the Sen family schools.

examples.japanese: {三千家|さんせんけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：30917_omotesenke⟧、⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：30918_urasenke⟧、{武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧。
examples.english: The 'three great Sen houses' refers to Omotesenke, Urasenke, and Mushanokojisenke.

examples.japanese: {武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧こそ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点前|てまえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}に→今に：01827_imani⟧⟦{伝|つた}えている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: Mushanokojisenke is small in scale, but it carries on its own distinctive tea-making style to this day.

notes:
{武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ} is the third of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony ({三千家|さんせんけ}), descended from the Sen family through a separate branch line.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Smaller in membership than ⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：30917_omotesenke⟧ and ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：30918_urasenke⟧, but equally old and equally respected; together the three schools are referred to as {三千家|さんせんけ}.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：30918_urasenke⟧: Urasenke, the largest of the three schools
